I don’t have access to live weather feeds, so I can’t give you the current conditions in London right now. However, I can share some general information about what you might expect:

| Season | Typical Weather |
|--------|-----------------|
| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | Cool to cold temperatures (average 2 °C–7 °C), frequent rain, occasional snow. |
| **Spring (Mar–May)** | Mild temperatures (10 °C–15 °C), increasing sunshine, still quite rainy. |
| **Summer (Jun–Aug)** | Warm but rarely hot (18 °C–25 °C), sunny days interspersed with brief showers. |
| **Autumn (Sep–Nov)** | Cooling down (12 °C–17 °C), more rain as the season progresses. |

If you’re planning a trip or just curious about today’s forecast, you could check a reliable weather website or app like the BBC Weather, Met Office, or a local news station. Let me know if you’d like tips on how to interpret those forecasts!
